notes:
One byte-limb of MUL, spelt the way the multiplier families spell it:
the carry out of the product is the expression (a * b - low) * inv(256), and it
is pinned by nothing except an enabler-gated range_check_8_11 whose (low, carry)
tuple the placement constraint forces live. No `bit()` touches the carry, so the
value-set renormalisation never fires; the window derived from the live request
is the only thing standing between the interval analysis and a 2^23-wide blowup,
and `low + 256*carry` spans [0, 2^19) < p so the decomposition of the shared
product is unique. The write-back gate reuses the AIR's inverse-marker idiom
(`addr * inv = nonzero`), whose `inv` is read by exactly one constraint and is
exactly the shape the projection rewrite eliminates. Expected verdict: unsat.
